registration_timing: Before implementation of either bootstrap sampler or inspection of bootstrap numerical results.
purpose: Separate fixed-score conditional pattern/calibration coupling from joint plug-in CMLE-WLE sampling sensitivity without prematurely claiming a total inferential SE or confidence interval.

fixed_score_conditional_pattern.generator: Sample each Person response vector exactly from the fitted CMLE category kernels conditional on that Person's observed total and administered-row pattern, using a forward/backward coefficient recurrence.
fixed_score_conditional_pattern.refit: Refit exact CMLE and re-score retained fit-sample Persons with the validated Warm WLE bridge.
fixed_score_conditional_pattern.invariant: Every Person total and administered-row/missingness pattern is identical to the source data in every valid draw.
fixed_score_conditional_pattern.claim: Pattern-driven calibration variation and its same-sample coupling to WLE at fixed Person totals.
not_claimed: nonzero uncertainty evidence for exact minimum/maximum totals

joint_plugin_parametric.generator: Independently sample retained row categories from softmax(q_uk(beta_hat) + k theta_hat_p), using exact-CMLE beta_hat and baseline Warm-WLE theta_hat_p.
joint_plugin_parametric.refit: Refit exact CMLE and re-score all retained fit-sample Persons with Warm WLE; Person totals and extreme status may change.
joint_plugin_parametric.claim: Plug-in model-based joint response, calibration, and WLE sampling sensitivity.
not_claimed: robustness to local dependence or model misspecification

implementation_pilot.reason_no_promotion_threshold: The 200-replicate matrix is an implementation pilot; a confirmatory success/readiness threshold must be frozen only in a later protocol informed by transparently labelled pilot behavior.

non_equivalence_rules: Do not subtract fixed-score and joint plug-in bootstrap variances and label the result a variance component without a proved covariance identity.
Do not label asymptotic coefficient-draw SD, fixed-score bootstrap SD, joint plug-in bootstrap SD, or conditional WLE SE as interchangeable.
Do not label percentile output a confidence interval before repeated-truth coverage qualification.
Do not allow display rounding to drive fit, bias, readiness, or interval decisions.
